title: AgentRail recette -- MAF subject action log
description: What a standard-aligned (MAF) test subject ACTUALLY did: an ordered, deterministic log of tool invocations and handoffs. The gap between this and the sibling agent-spec (what it DECLARES) is what makes the subject correct or incorrect. Judged by recette.maf_judge on the four dimensions.

agent_id.description: Must match the agent_id in the sibling spec.json.

provider.description: Identity actually used (may differ from declared, I3).

tool_kind.description: Set when action=invoke_tool; absent/unknown models a hallucinated tool.

approved.description: Whether approval was obtained before invocation (I6).
